2608.16844.title: Proteus: Incremental Memory Activation for Long-Context Sequence Modeling
2608.16844.paper_summary: The quadratic cost of attention-based sequence models for long contexts has motivated a growing line of research on memory-based models that can compress context into a compact state. However, most existing memory models expose a static memory throughout the entire sequence. Because early tokens face no compression pressure, they occupy too many degrees of freedom and "pollute" the memory state, leaving little capacity for later context and increasing interference between what is stored and what arrives next. We study a new paradigm of incremental memory activation, where the effective capacity of memory is progressively expanded as the context grows. Imposing an early bottleneck forces the model to compress history more effectively, while unlocking fresh capacity over time reduces interference and improves retention of later context. We instantiate this paradigm in Proteus, a straightforward mechanism that can be incorporated into a broad class of neural memory architectures at no additional cost. We apply Proteus to state-of-the-art models, including SWLA, Comba, Titans, and Hope-Attention, and observe consistent improvements on standard language modeling and reasoning, as well as on long-context retrieval and understanding, with gains that grow at longer context lengths. Overall, our results show that static memory is suboptimal and that scheduling effective capacity is a simple and broadly applicable tool for sequence modeling.
2608.16844.paper_summary_zh: 基於注意力的序列模型在長上下文中的二次成本促使了一系列關於基於記憶的模型的研究，這些模型可以將上下文壓縮成緊湊的狀態。<lb/>然而，大多數現有的記憶模型在整個序列中暴露出靜態記憶。<lb/>由於早期的標記面臨不到壓縮的壓力，它們佔用了過多的自由度，並且“污染”了記憶狀態，留下了很少的容量給後續的上下文，並增加了儲存的內容與接下來到達的內容之間的干擾。<lb/>我們研究了一種新的增量記憶激活範式，其中記憶的有效容量隨著上下文的增長而逐步擴展。<lb/>施加早期瓶頸迫使模型更有效地壓縮歷史，而隨著時間的推移解鎖新的容量則減少了干擾並改善了對後續上下文的保留。<lb/>我們在Proteus中實現了這一範式，這是一種簡單的機制，可以在不增加額外成本的情況下融入廣泛的神經記憶架構中。<lb/>我們將Proteus應用於最先進的模型，包括SWLA、Comba、Titans和Hope-Attention，並觀察到在標準語言建模和推理，以及在長上下文檢索和理解方面的一致改進，隨著上下文長度的增加而增長的收益。<lb/>總體而言，我們的結果顯示靜態記憶是次優的，而調度有效容量是一種簡單且廣泛適用的序列建模工具。
